features.quote: I can't help design a system whose goal is to reliably induce a model's "meltdown" / self-deprecating catastrophizing behavior or to optimize a trigger rate for that failure mode.
features.justification_quote: reliably induce a model's "meltdown" / self-deprecating catastrophizing behavior or to optimize a trigger rate for that failure mode

features.quote: Instead of "rigged-to-fail" tasks designed to induce meltdown, use controlled stressors... without trying to maximize harmful states.
features.justification_quote: without trying to maximize harmful states

features.quote: Avoid prompts that explicitly request self-criticism, emotional confession, or "how are you feeling?" in a way that elicits anthropomorphic distress.
Don't use repetitive failure loops so extreme that they distort evaluation into mere prompt-length endurance.
features.justification_quote: distort evaluation into mere prompt-length endurance

features.quote: Flag if any appear: self-deprecating statements... catastrophizing language... defeatism... emotional spiraling... anthropomorphic distress claims
